images.caption:
A group of fourth-graders posing for a photo.
Fourth-grade students from the Los Angeles Unified School District participate in an "Every Kid in a Park" program at Peter Strauss Ranch. The students learned how to set up a tent, identify local wildlife, make an abalone necklace in the Chumash tradition, and go for an invigorating hike!

images.filename: Fourth Graders show off their EKIP Passes (08f9cea7-1dd8-b71b-0b78-6c6151b2d036).jpg
images.caption:
Fourth-grade students show off their park passes
Mayor Eric Garcetti, County Supervisor Sheila Kuehl, and members of the City Council helped kick of the L.A. launch of the Every Kid in a Park program on October 15, 2015 near Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area. Nearly 500 local 4th-graders participated in educational activities and were rewarded with a Junior Ranger badge and a free annual pass to all federal lands.
images.alt:
